anchor: .labelbtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--catcolor2); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; }

copy: .labelrow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; }
.lqty { display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
.lqty button { border: 0; background: var(--catbg2, #F1F4EC); min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
.lqty output { min-width: 40px; text-align: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

anchor: /* Prep Labels app: recipes with a printable prep label get a button that opens the app on that item. */
copy: const IN_LABELS_APP = (() => { try { return window.self !== window.top; } catch (e) { return true; } })();
// Inside the label page, "Print prep label" asks it to print right away; the book stays on this page.
function labelQty(a){ const o = a.parentElement.querySelector(".lqty output"); return o ? parseInt(o.textContent, 10) || 1 : 1; }
function labelText(n){ return n === 1 ? "Print prep label" : "Print " + n + " labels"; }
const row = q.closest(".labelrow"), o = row.querySelector(".lqty output"), a = row.querySelector("a.labelbtn");
const mv = document.querySelector("#batchToggle .batchval");   // the page's Multiply Batch setting starts the batch count
window.parent.postMessage({ type: "ypl-print", item: a.dataset.item, qty: labelQty(a), mult: mv ? parseInt(mv.textContent, 10) || 1 : 1 }, PARENT_ORIGIN);
if (d.ok && o) o.textContent = "1";               // back to 1 so a second tap doesn't repeat a big batch by accident
if (!msg) { msg = document.createElement("div"); msg.className = "labelmsg"; msg.setAttribute("role", "status"); a.after(msg); }
// Taps in the book count as using the app, so the label page keeps (or takes back) the printer.
const now = Date.now(); if (now - lastPing < 5000) return; lastPing = now;
